annotation.interpretation_a: A client could choose to accept an RRSet even if some SvcParams within it are inconsistent, processing only the consistent ones.
annotation.interpretation_b: A client could choose to reject the entire RRSet if any SvcParams are inconsistent, even if some are valid.
annotation.justification: The use of "MAY" creates ambiguity. It is unclear whether the client is permitted to accept a partially valid RRSet or must reject the entire set upon finding any inconsistency. A missing constraint would specify whether partial acceptance is allowed.
